name: Ambermill Investigations
summary: In Ambermill, Dalaran wizards are weaving magic that threatens the Forsaken's hold on Silverpine Forest. Shadow Priest Allister sends agents from the Sepulcher to disrupt their spellwork and seize the magical foci.

sections.title: A Threat from the East
sections.body: Ambermill is a human town in the hills of eastern Silverpine Forest, held by wizards and defenders pledged to the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. The mages are weaving magical energies in a vast ritual. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister and his companion Dalar recognize the danger. If the Kirin Tor channel their power unchecked, the Forsaken risk being driven from Silverpine entirely.

sections.title: Disrupting the Weave
sections.body: While Dalar scries the forest and traces the flow of magic, Allister sends agents to strike the practitioners in Ambermill. Dalaran conjurers, mages, and their protectors wear enchanted pendants that focus and coordinate their arts. Taking the talismans from slain sorcerers disrupts the ritual and gives the Sepulcher time to find the ringleader directing the arcane weave.

faq.q: Why is Shadow Priest Allister targeting Ambermill?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor mages in Ambermill are channeling powerful arcane energies. Allister fears their spellcasting could cost the Forsaken control of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What are the Dalaran Pendants used for?
faq.answer: Dalaran conjurers, mages, and protectors wear the pendants as focuses for their craft. Taking them weakens the wizards' efforts and helps Allister study the Kirin Tor's magical progress.
Ambermill lies in the eastern hills of Silverpine Forest. From the Sepulcher, head south along the main thoroughfare, then follow the fork east into town.

faq.q: Who is Dalar, and how is he involved?
faq.answer: Dalar is a Forsaken practitioner at the Sepulcher with Shadow Priest Allister. He tracks and seeks to uncover the magical sources fueling the Dalaran wizards in Ambermill.

faq.q: What happens after recovering the pendants?
faq.answer: The pendants show that the Dalaran ritual is already well advanced, led by an adept wizard. That wizard must be confronted to halt the spellcasting entirely.

faq.q: Why are Dalaran humans still in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Ambermill was a minor lumber town. After their kingdom was devastated, the surviving Kirin Tor took an interest in the town and still hold it against the Scourge and Forsaken.

angles.text: The Kirin Tor remnants in Ambermill are near the Undercity's territory. Their magical work threatens Forsaken survival.
As a mage, you know the precise coordination a large arcane ritual demands. Severing the Kirin Tor's enchanted foci disrupts their spellcraft.
As a member of the Horde, you know holding Silverpine Forest protects Lordaeron's western approaches from Alliance-aligned outposts loyal to Dalaran.
